class LapID:

[docs]
    def laplacian(self):
            # Weight Type
        B = self.kind

        # Name/Region
        N = self.region

        with as_file(files("sgwt").joinpath(f"data/{B}/{N}_{B}.npz")) as lap_path:
            return load_npz(lap_path)

def impulse(lap, n=0):
    '''
    Returns a numpy array dirac impulse at vertex n of compatible shape with L
    '''
    b = zeros((lap.shape[0],1))
    b[n] = 1

    return b
